reviewed_by: Lead static review against Binary Ninja and Radare2 disassembly, plus the retail-execution differential report docs/fidelity/evidence/0x004BDA00-behavioral.json

inputs: value_stack and type_stack contents at the touched slot
outputs: value word written to value_stack[new index]
type tag word written to type_stack[new index] (constant 1)
sideEffects: caller-provided QVM state: two index fields and two stack slots are overwritten

runtime_contract.note: The retail PE is emulated and the native is executed with the three cdecl arguments on the emulated stack; the same inputs are fed to the compiled candidate by the same runner. Stack indices and slot words are compared exactly. Caller state allocation, the QVM interpreter loop and opcode dispatch are outside this native's contract.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both report the single function entry at 0x004BDA00 (Binary Ninja label Sys_PushStack_29) with a one-block CFG and no outgoing edges; the candidate implements exactly that entry and no sibling.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail instructions read the state pointer from [esp+4] and the 32-bit value from [esp+8] (cdecl); the candidate takes (QvmNativeStatePrefix* state, std::uint32_t value) in the same order. The retail leaves the pushed value in EAX, but every recovered caller discards the result, so the candidate declares void and the residual register is excluded from the compared contract.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The only literal is the integer type tag 1U stored into the type stack, matching the retail immediate. The state field offsets used by the candidate (0x18, 0x1C, 0x24, 0x28) are the retail displacements; no scaling or shift is involved.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail writes [[state+0x28]+type_index*4] and [[state+0x24]+value_index*4] after the decrements; the candidate indexes type_stack[] and value_stack[] with the same 4-byte stride and the same slot order (type tag written first, then the value). Byte offsets inside the candidate struct differ on a 64-bit host, so the differential compares stack indices and slot words rather than raw struct offsets.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The retail native makes no call; its only side effects are the two index decrements and the two stack-slot writes into the caller-provided state. The candidate performs exactly those four writes and no others.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: There is no error path and no branch: the retail function has one basic block and always executes the same stores. The candidate likewise has no conditional. The retail's residual EAX (the pushed value) is not part of the recovered contract because no caller reads it; the pushed value is instead observed through the value stack.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The native moves 32-bit integers only; no floating-point load, store or arithmetic appears in the retail disassembly or the candidate.
